manifest.name: dsh-boss-worker
manifest.author: kongbai9420
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness 多模型流程工作台：节点选择模型、依赖并行、独立验收、需求证据与用量监控

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: lead-worker
      name: "dsh-boss-worker"
      config:
        defaultConfig:
          enabled: true
          mode: mixed
          maxRetries: 2
          confirmPlan: true
          askApprovalPrompt: true
          members:
            - id: worker-sol
              name: "Sol (代码执行与实现)"
              provider: "deepseek-official"
              model: "deepseek-v4-pro"
              role: "负责代码编写、文件修改、功能实现与自测"
              instructions: "全程中文；严格按任务范围执行，实现并测试后报告文件改动与验证证据。"
              enabled: true
              readOnly: false
            - id: worker-qa
              name: "QA 测试员 (验证与审查)"
              provider: "deepseek-official"
              model: "deepseek-flash"
              role: "负责测试、验证和质量把关"
              instructions: "全程中文，只读审查实现与测试，提供缺陷依据和验证结果。"
              enabled: true
              readOnly: true

readme.text: <div align="center">

**用节点选择模型，用流程组织协作，用证据完成交付。** 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多模型流程工作台 [](CHANGELOG.md) [](COMPATIBILITY.md) [](LICENSE) **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md) [快速开始](#快速开始) · [工作方式](#工作方式) · [文档中心](docs/README.md) · [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) --- > [!NOTE] > 当前版本为 **[`0.2.0-beta.28` · Beta 预发布版](https://github.com/kongbai9420/dsh-boss-worker/releases/tag/v0.2.0-beta.28)**。验证范围见下文，安装包与校验文件见 Release。

在 DSH 官方“流程”页签中，把需求拆为节点，为每个节点选择 Provider / 模型，再用连线表达依赖、审查与返工。从草案到交付，模型配置、执行状态和验收依据都有记录。

| 能力 | 使用体验 |
| --- | --- |
| 节点配置模型 | 直接选择执行模型与独立验收模型，无需维护执行成员池 |
| 分支与汇合 | 满足依赖、写入范围不冲突的独立节点并行执行 |
| 可编辑的流程 | 拖拽连线、布局切换、撤销重做、Skill 绑定、模板导入导出 |
| 按依据验收 | 原需求逐项对账，保留核验历史，区分失败与证据不足 |
| 显式返工 | 按画布中的封驳连线重做目标及受影响下游 |
| 运行可观测 | 查看节点调用、返工、独立验收、Token 与预估费用 |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[需求与规划] --> B[方案审查]
    B --> C[前端实现]
    B --> D[后端实现]

这是分支、汇合与返工的概念示例。实际依赖由画布连线决定，内置全栈模板还包含架构、UX 与交付等节点。

**不再设置执行成员数量或最大并发数。** 同一模型可以创建多个独立执行实例；运行时按依赖和申报的写入范围调度，写冲突排队。同一个主控直接执行上下文仍保持串行。

| 流程类型 | 适合场景 | 规则 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 并行流程 · `kind=dag` | 自由搭建分支与汇合；新模板默认使用 | `passed` 依赖必须无环；`rejected` 返回前置节点或自身 |
| 模型接管链 · 不指定 `kind` | 同一任务顺次切换模型 | 支持通过、封驳、返工超限、超时与错误；每个条件一个后继 |
| 治理编排 · `kind=orchestration` | 三省六部、全栈开发团队 | 结构化规划、方案审议、分工、汇合、最终验收与报告 |
并行流程有多个末端且未显式汇合时，应用后增加可见的“汇合交付与验收”节点。接管图出现同一起点的多个通过后继时，按并行流程识别和校验。详见[节点与流程](docs/WORKFLOW.md)。

1. 在 DSH 配置可用 Provider 和模型，通过应用内插件管理安装本地插件包。 2. 打开官方 **流程** 页签，选择模板或新建流程。 3. 为节点选择模型、职责、Skill、写入范围、返工预算与超时；按需调整独立验收模型。 4. 用 **通过** 连线建立依赖，用 **封驳** 连线指定返工目标。 5. 保存草案，或应用到未启动任务；按当前审批策略批准或启动编排。 6. 在运行记录与需求对账中核对成果，补齐原需求的有效验收依据后交付。 预览、保存和应用流程不会立即调用模型。已应用节点保存执行与验收模型快照，修改共享目录不会悄悄替换正在使用的模型。
界面预览 · 节点直接选择模型 离线交互验证截图，展示模板编辑、节点模型和职责配置。`offline / C` 为测试夹具。

使用 Node.js 24（与仓库 CI 一致）。

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/kongbai9420/dsh-boss-worker.git
cd dsh-boss-worker
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --ignore-scripts
npm run build:client

产物为本地 `.tgz` 安装包；请核对当前检出源码中的 `package.json` 版本。`client/` 是前端源码，`client.js` 是构建产物。宿主契约检查还需要官方 DSH 依赖，安装及执行方式见 [CI 配置](.github/workflows/check.yml)。

离线体验工作台：

```powershell
node scripts/preview-workbench.mjs
```

按终端提示打开本地地址。预览使用临时 Profile 与离线模型，不操作真实会话、不产生模型调用费用。

| 环节 | 当前行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 质量与证据 | 已确认失败不能被模型 `passed=true` 放行；证据不足时保留成果等待补充核验 |
| 最终交付 | 逐条核对原需求的版本、状态和可复核依据；口头总结不能替代证据 |
| 核验修正 | 同版本、同执行轮次采用最近一次可信核验，保留历史；执行者自报不能覆盖可信结论 |
| 独立验收 | 新建实现节点默认使用独立审查上下文；人工核验需先记录依据再审查 |
| 只读审查 | 检查文件与已有证据；执行测试交给测试节点 |
| 暂停调度 | 停止新派发，已启动调用继续结算；中断、取消和停工排空分别处理 |
| 取消与恢复 | 取消上游会阻塞相关下游；重启后中断任务需核查并确认恢复 |

`writeScopes` 用于任务契约、调度冲突和交付检查，**不是文件系统硬隔离**。模型执行仍遵循宿主沙箱与审批。BOSS 直派、全自动托管为会话私有开关，返工与审批默认值沿用共享设置。

节点累计包含返工和独立验收，并按实际 Provider / 模型记录用量。用量设置直接选择可用模型添加单价，支持官方参考报价、手动覆盖、显示单位与显式换算。

**会话预算用于提醒，不会自动停机。** 未知用量与未计价费用会明确显示；预估费用不代表实际账单、订阅额度或账户余额。详见[运行监控](docs/RUNTIME_MONITORING.md)。

最近验证日期：**2026-10-27**。以下为本地记录，不代表远端 GitHub Actions 已运行。

| 检查 | 结果与范围 |
| --- | --- |
| 单元与业务回归 | **412 通过，0 失败，0 跳过** |
| 官方宿主与前端契约 | DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`、`0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2` 均通过 |
| 界面交互 | 离线验证模板编辑、节点模型选择、保存与重新打开 |
| 真实 Provider | 完整付费任务、限流与账单对照仍待独立验收 |

兼容测试使用真实官方宿主依赖和离线模型夹具。详细记录见[兼容性](COMPATIBILITY.md)。旧 `members` / `memberId` 和 `maxParallel` 仅用于迁移兼容；不再表示执行实例数量或调度上限。

**Choose models per node. Coordinate with workflows. Deliver with evidence.** A multi-model workflow workbench for DeepSeek Harness [](docs/CHANGELOG.en.md) [](docs/COMPATIBILITY.en.md) [](LICENSE) [简体中文](README.md) · **English** [Quick start](#quick-start) · [How it works](#how-it-works) · [Documentation](docs/README.en.md) · [Changelog](docs/CHANGELOG.en.md) ---

> [!NOTE]
> Current version: **[`0.2.0-beta.28` · Beta pre-release](https://github.com/kongbai9420/dsh-boss-worker/releases/tag/v0.2.0-beta.28)**. See verification boundaries below and download the package and checksums from the Release.

Turn requirements into nodes in DSH's official workflow tab. Choose a Provider / model for each node, then connect dependencies, reviews and rework. Model configurations, execution states and acceptance evidence stay recorded from draft to delivery.

| Capability | What you get |
| --- | --- |
| Models per node | Choose execution and independent review models directly, without maintaining a worker pool |
| Branches and joins | Independent nodes run in parallel when dependencies pass and declared write scopes do not conflict |
| Editable workflows | Drag connections, change layout, undo/redo, attach Skills, import/export templates |
| Evidence-based acceptance | Reconcile original requirements, retain verification history and distinguish failure from missing evidence |
| Explicit rework | Re-execute the rejection target and affected downstream nodes along canvas routes |
| Runtime visibility | Inspect node calls, rework, independent review, Token usage and estimated cost |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Requirements and planning] --> B[Plan review]
    B --> C[Frontend implementation]
    B --> D[Backend implementation]

This conceptual example shows branching, joining and rework. Canvas connections define actual dependencies; the built-in full-stack template also includes architecture, UX and delivery nodes.

**There is no worker-count or maximum-concurrency setting.** The same model can create multiple independent execution instances. Scheduling follows dependencies and declared write scopes; conflicting writes queue. A single direct controller execution context remains serial.

| Workflow type | Best for | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Parallel graph · `kind=dag` | Custom branches and joins; the default for new templates | `passed` dependencies must be acyclic; `rejected` returns to a predecessor or the same node |
| Model handoff chain · no `kind` | Switching models sequentially for one task | Pass, rejection, rework limit, timeout and error routes; one successor per condition |
| Governed orchestration · `kind=orchestration` | Three Departments and Six Ministries; full-stack team | Structured planning, plan review, delegation, joining, final acceptance and reporting |

Applying a parallel graph with multiple terminal nodes and no explicit join adds a visible delivery-and-acceptance join. A handoff graph with multiple passing successors from one node is identified and validated as a parallel graph. See the [workflow guide](docs/WORKFLOW.en.md).

1. Configure available Providers and models in DSH, then install the local package through the app's plugin manager.
2. Open the official **workflow** tab and select a template or create a workflow.
3. Choose each node's model, responsibility, Skills, write scopes, rework budget and timeout. Adjust its independent review model as needed.
4. Connect **pass** routes for dependencies and **rejection** routes for rework targets.
5. Save a draft or apply it to an unstarted task. Approve or start orchestration under the current approval policy.
6. Check results in execution records and requirement reconciliation; deliver once the original requirements have valid acceptance evidence.

Previewing, saving and applying a workflow do not immediately call models. Applied nodes retain snapshots of execution and review configurations; editing the shared catalog does not silently change their models.
Interface preview · Choose a model directly on a node Screenshot from offline interaction verification, showing template editing, model selection and responsibilities. `offline / C` is a test fixture. The interface shown is in Chinese.

Use Node.js 24, matching the repository CI.

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/kongbai9420/dsh-boss-worker.git
cd dsh-boss-worker
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --ignore-scripts
npm run build:client

This creates a local `.tgz` package. Check `package.json` in your checkout for its version. `client/` contains frontend sources; `client.js` is generated. Host contract checks also require official DSH dependencies; see the [CI configuration](.github/workflows/check.yml) for installation and execution.

Try the offline workbench:

```powershell
node scripts/preview-workbench.mjs
```
Open the local address printed in the terminal. Preview uses a temporary Profile and offline models; it does not operate on real sessions or incur model API charges.

| Area | Current behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Quality and evidence | A model's `passed=true` cannot override a confirmed failure; missing evidence preserves results pending verification |
| Final delivery | Reconcile each original requirement's version, status and reviewable reference; a verbal summary is insufficient |
| Verification corrections | The latest trusted verification within the same version and execution epoch applies; history remains, and worker self-reports cannot override trusted conclusions |
| Independent acceptance | New implementation nodes default to an independent review context; manual verification requires recorded evidence before review |
| Read-only review | Inspect files and existing evidence; test execution belongs to test nodes |
| Pause scheduling | Stop new dispatches while started calls settle; interruption, cancellation and draining are distinct actions |
| Cancellation and recovery | Cancelling upstream work blocks affected dependants; interrupted work requires inspection and confirmation after restart |

`writeScopes` supports task contracts, conflict scheduling and delivery checks; **it is not filesystem isolation**. Execution follows the host sandbox and approvals. BOSS direct dispatch and automatic management are session-private switches; rework and approval defaults retain shared settings.

Node totals include rework and independent review, attributed to the actual Provider / model. Add prices directly from available models; use official reference prices, manual overrides, display units and explicit conversions.

**Session budgets are reminders and do not stop execution.** Unknown usage and unpriced costs are explicit. Estimates do not represent invoices, subscription quotas or account balances. See [runtime monitoring](docs/RUNTIME_MONITORING.en.md).
Last verified: **2026-10-27**. These are local records, not a claim that remote GitHub Actions have run.

| Check | Result and scope |
| --- | --- |
| Unit and business regression tests | **412 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped** |
| Official host and frontend contracts | Passed on DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2` |
| Interface interaction | Offline template editing, model selection, saving and reopening verified |
| Live Providers | Full paid tasks, rate limits and invoice reconciliation still require separate acceptance |

Compatibility tests use real official host dependencies with offline model fixtures. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.en.md). Legacy `members` / `memberId` and `maxParallel` remain migration inputs; they no longer represent execution-instance counts or scheduling limits.
